'''Remmers''' were a [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. Variants included the highland remmer.

Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the collector [[Jener Mich]] tasked a group of spacers to hunt and kill an unreasonable number of remmers.<ref name="SWG:RR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Remmer Repressor}}</ref>
